title: Blood Debt at Demon Emperor Palace
summary: Ye Fan finishes the Wang 13th Elder and sends a survivor back with a message: the Myriad Things Mother Qi Cauldron is back and Ye Fan is waiting in the south. Wang Chengkun, head of the Wang clan and Wang Teng's father (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven), gathers warships and goes to the Southern Ridge's Demon Emperor Palace to ask Qi Lin to join the ancient races, now that the Heavenly Emperor's Son is about to rise. Qi Lin politely refuses and mocks the fire in Wang's own backyard. Ye Fan destroys the Wang warships, takes on Wang Chengkun's forces alone and kills him, promising Wang Teng is next. He also kills two Divine Spirit Valley envoys who serve Zi Tianfeng. Li Tian and Yan Yixi arrive too late for the fight, and Ye Fan explains that he is drawing every enemy onto himself to protect his hidden friends. Qi Lin reports that Zi Tianfeng cornered Dongfang Ye (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven) at Falling Eagle Cliff, leaving only blood behind, and warns of other ancient-race prodigies: Huang Xudao, Monk Shen Can and Yuan Gu. Ye Fan asks Qi Lin for a teleportation array to go after Divine Spirit Valley that same night.
